After being without a son for many years, Go Yeonu dreams that he will soon have one. One day, he hears of a woman who caught a sacrificial pig that had escaped. Go Yeonu seeks her out, and the two spend the night together after he promises that he will not abandon her should she become pregnant. Later, upon learning that she is with child, Go Yeonu keeps his promise and brings her into his household. That same year, she bears him a son.
